facts.fact: The Legislature of Liberia enacted an Act to amend the Executive Law and establish the Liberia Standards Authority, which carries the preamble citing ECOWAS quality infrastructure and WTO TBT obligations; the capture holds only the preamble, so it names no national standard on information technology or data. The document gives no date of enactment, so the published date 2022-08-05 is used.

systems.owner: Government of Liberia, established by Act of the Legislature

note: Excerpt only (preamble and enacting clause): no standard and no certification stated; the Liberia National Quality Policy is a quality policy, so class other and not a fact.
